comments.body:
I do not believe we will be requiring actors be identified by WebIDs:

https://github.com/fcrepo/fcrepo-specification/pull/207/files

The identity of the actor shall be provided by the kernel API that will be created in:

https://jira.duraspace.org/browse/FCREPO-2608

This can be worked on pending 

https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/pull/1232. 

... and the resolution to 

https://jira.duraspace.org/browse/FCREPO-2608

The updates are in place and ready for review.

https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/pull/1232

 

Sorry this is the correct PR:

https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/pull/1243
